settings.heading: One finishing gesture.
settings.body: The detail that makes everything else feel intentional.

settings.heading: Give one detail the lead.
settings.body:
A sculptural earring can frame a simple neckline. A scarf introduces a new direction. An accessory can repeat a color already in the outfit or introduce a deliberate contrast.

Start with one element and look at its relationship to everything around it. The strongest choice is often the one that feels natural to you.
